Pair a phone to control playback and volume from it
On the TV open Settings → TV remote and frame the QR code with the phone camera.

The code expired or was already used: show a new code on the TV.

Play, pause, seek, subtitles, volume and more
Removes the pairing from this phone and, when it is reachable, from the TV.

The phone shows what Nuvio is playing on the TV and controls it: play and pause, seek by the interval set on the TV, skip intro and recap, next episode, subtitles and volume. Phone and TV talk only on your local network, encrypted with a key created when pairing. Nuvio must be open on the TV.
Nothing is playing on the TV
The volume is controlled by the TV itself (HDMI-CEC)
The TV can not do that right now
Connection lost: the controls come back when the TV answers

Controls of the Nuvio TV paired with this phone
Controls in notification and lock screen

When the TV is found online or starts playing, control it from the notification, the lock screen and the volume keys, even with Nuvio closed. They close by themselves after 10 minutes with nothing playing.
Shown on the TV under the QR code, e.g. 192.168.1.50 (port 47380 is the default).
Invalid address: use an IP like 192.168.1.50, optionally followed by :port.
Looking for TVs on the network…
On the TV open Settings → TV remote: it shows up here. Phone and TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
%1$s · tap to pair with the code shown on the TV
Use the address and the pairing code shown on the TV under the QR code.
Type the pairing code shown on the TV in Settings → TV remote.
The code has 8 letters and numbers, as shown on the TV.
Wrong code: check the code shown on the TV. After 5 wrong attempts the TV shows a new one.
Frame the QR code shown on the TV in Settings → TV remote.
This is not a Nuvio TV code
The camera is used only to read the QR code shown on the TV. You can also pair with the address and the code instead.
Read and share the app logs of the TV from the phone
Connected: the logs update every few seconds
The TV does not answer: retrying…
Changes the "Record logs" setting of the TV. With it off, the TV saves no new log lines
